review:
Le Pharaoh sends Smokey to Egypt with Sticky Re-drops at its core. Any winning combination locks in place and awards a re-drop. Symbols that extend the win or create new ones also stick, and the sequence repeats until nothing new connects. Every stuck paying symbol leaves a Golden Square behind.

If a Rainbow symbol is on the grid, those Golden Squares open to reveal coins, clovers and pots, so a long re-drop chain also sets up a bigger reveal. The two features work well together, and the 15,000x ceiling sits a little above the studio's usual 10,000x. This is one of the few Hacksaw games where two independent databases agree on the RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: RTP comes from third-party databases, not from Hacksaw
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
